description_en: Performs a manual primary/secondary switchover for an edge cluster
name: FailoverDBClusterZonal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the edge cloud cluster. Only edge cluster IDs returned by DescribeDBClustersZonal are accepted. Standard PolarDB cluster IDs are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 边缘云集群 ID。仅接受 DescribeDBClustersZonal 返回的边缘集群 ID；普通 PolarDB 集群 ID 不适用
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the edge cluster node to be switched to the primary node. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically elects a primary node. You can call DescribeDbClusterAttributeZonal to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 要切换为主节点的边缘集群节点 ID；不填时系统自动选举。可通过 DescribeDbClusterAttributeZonal 查询节点 ID
parameters.name: target_db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to switch back to the original primary zone after a failover. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否是故障切换后的回切至原主可用区，取值范围如下：

true：是。
false：不是
parameters.name: roll_back_for_disaster

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and is case-sensitive. It can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a primary/secondary switchover within the primary zone. Valid values:

Primary: Performs a primary/secondary switchover within the primary zone.
Standby: Switches to the hot standby storage cluster
parameters.help_zh:
是否是主可用区内主备切换，取值如下：

Primary：主可用区内主备切换。
Standby：切换至存储热备集群
parameters.name: target_zone_type
